Name: WRC Powerslide
Overview:
WRC Powerslide is an arcade racing game set in the World Rally Championship universe. It features fast-paced gameplay where players race against three opponents on iconic rally stages. The game emphasizes fun and accessibility, making it suitable for both casual and competitive players.

Key Features
Gameplay
Racing Style: Players can use power-ups during races to gain advantages over opponents.
Car Handling: The game offers an intuitive handling model, allowing players to master drifting and acceleration easily.
Multiplayer Options: Compete against friends or AI in various modes, including ghost racing and multiplayer leaderboards.

Cars and Tracks
Vehicle Selection: Players can choose from a variety of real-world cars across different classes, including WRC Class, Class 2, and Class 3.
Stages: Race on famous tracks from the World Rally Championship, such as Monte Carlo and Sardinia.
